Analyst, Financial Analysis

World-leading approaches in finance are fundamental to our success. Our Financial Analysis team has a broad and important responsibility. We rely on our analysts to develop, interpret, and implement financial concepts for planning and control. Their technical analysis of present and future financial performance informs all kinds of management decisions and strategies. And their research has an impact on everything from acquisitions and investments to customer deals, working capital requirements and forecasting.

What you’ll achieve:

As an Analyst, you will support data preparation, reconciliations and reporting for planning and performance reviews, building experience across FP&A workflows. You’ll assist with templates and documentation that keep cycles on track. This role offers broad exposure and growth in corporate finance.

Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an Analyst on our Financial Analysis team.

## Responsibilities

You will:

• Get an opportunity to launch you career while gaining insight and experience in a variety of financial, operational, and analytical areas

• Ensure that the internal financial reporting requirements of the company are met

• Help develop and maintain financial models and reports

• Experience international rotations for top performers while networking with senior leaders and executives

• Gather, evaluate, prepare, and summarize recommendations for financial plans, acquisition activity, customer deals, trended future requirements and operating forecasts

## Qualifications

Take the first step towards your dream career

Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role:

Essential Requirements

Chartered accountant qualified in 2026 only as finance development program is for entry level candidates
• Adaptability and Resilience: With regular rotations as part of structure
• adaptability
• resilience to quickly learn and contribute back is critical
Finance Acumen: Ability to function as a Finance partner to stakeholder
• Analytical Skills: The ability to interpret financial data
• identify trends
• and draw meaningful conclusions from the data
• Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential for interacting with colleagues
• clients
• and vendors
• Problem-Solving: The ability to identify financial issues
• suggest solutions
• and make data-driven recommendations
Excel and other Advanced Data analysis Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Power BI and other AI tools

Desirable Requirements

Qualified Chartered Accountant 2026 Pass out only
